_header: Gate-0 oracle closure set. Frozen at Gate-0 sign-off (2026-07-03), reconciled and re-frozen under Stage-2 entry criterion E2.a (2026-07-05, Eric-approved). Append-never: corrections require a new PLAN amendment + Eric sign-off (PLAN 4). Built by reconciliation, NOT re-derived from any single run. The E2.a-frozen reproducible closure is 170 (163 local + 7 HPC); the 4-spec gap vs the 171 sign-off prose is RESOLVED (see reconciliation.e2a).

e2a.method: The 171-vs-167 gap = exactly the 4 open-residue specs carrying 'closed' claims in GATE0_STATUS.md (26 reproducible-open minus 22 prose-open). Each dispositioned with committed evidence; 3 re-closed, 1 was a genuine overcount.

dispositions.57: RE-CLOSED -> closed_hpc. GATE0_STATUS 'HPC sweep: Closed -- 7' lists 57 but closed_hpc previously listed only 6 (transcription omission). Evidence: results/runs/sweep-large-57 (sany=pass, tlc=fail_invariant on FindSolution @503s); populations.json classifies 57 expected_violation:FindSolution. Valid closure under the population-aware criterion; requires large-budget/HPC compute (not laptop-budget reproducible), same class as the other 6 HPC closures.
dispositions.135: RE-CLOSED -> closed_local. Reproduced 2026-07-05 (results/runs/e2a-reconcile-135-141): sany=pass, tlc=pass, vacuity=clean @64.3s at --jobs 1. Genuine pass; fails only under --jobs 8 CPU contention (TIMEOUT_CONTENTION.md). SERIAL CAVEAT below.
dispositions.141: RE-CLOSED -> closed_local. Reproduced 2026-07-05 (results/runs/e2a-reconcile-135-141): sany=pass, tlc=pass, vacuity=clean @81.1s at --jobs 1. cfg substitutes Succ<-ConnectedToSomeButNotAll (defined in spec 135). Fails only under --jobs 8 contention. SERIAL CAVEAT below.
dispositions.47: OVERCOUNT -> stays OPEN (residue). GATE0_STATUS line 165 'Closed specs this way' counted 47 among sibling-wrapper closures, but SIBLING_WRAPPERS.md line 33 records it as 'wired, times out -- same large state space as spec 48', and spec 48 is certified intractable (APALACHE_FINDINGS.md). The wrapper mechanism was applied (no longer a parse/config error) but the spec does not close. This is the single genuine overcount in the 171 figure.

e2a.serial_caveat: Specs 135 and 141 close at --jobs 1 (serial) within the 90s budget but time out under --jobs 8 due to CPU contention (harness/TIMEOUT_CONTENTION.md). The closed_local reproduction command below reproduces the full set ONLY when run serially or at low --jobs for these two.

closed_local.evidence: re-run `python3 -m harness run --stages sany,tlc --jobs 1` (oracle machinery, serial to avoid the 135/141 contention false-timeout); reproduces this set.

closed_hpc.evidence: GATE0_STATUS.md 'HPC sweep' + APALACHE_FINDINGS.md + results/runs/sweep-large-*; pass only at large budgets (24-worker / 5.5h, or long serial TLC). Includes spec 57 (expected_violation:FindSolution, fail_invariant @503s, sweep-large-57).
